plainText:
Meeting the Ultra Recon Squad (Japanese: 邂逅！！ウルトラ調査隊！ Encounter!! The !) is the 27th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
and meet Dulse and Zossie of the Ultra Recon Squad.
Dulse reveals that he worked with the Aether Foundation simply to make Poké Balls capable of capturing Ultra Beasts.
Lunala returns to Sun and Moon.
Dulse agrees to stay behind while Zossie goes with Sun and Moon on Lunala.
With Zossie's guidance, Sun and Moon arrive at the Ultra Megalopolis.
